result: h07. **Trace: `GET /file/users/{username}/avatar` → `user.avatar_url` column** The image is not a separate blob/file — it is stored as a base64 data URI in the `user` table's `avatar_url` column, and the handler decodes it on the way out. **How the browser gets that URL:** the API converter rewrites the raw base64 into a URL so responses stay small — `convertUserToProto` sets `AvatarUrl = "/file/%s/avatar"` (with `userpb.Name` = `users/{username}`) at `server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:36`; `UserAvatar` then renders it as an `` (`web/src/components/UserAvatar.tsx`). Hops: ``` RegisterRoutes (GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124 serveUserAvatar — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168 getUserByUsername — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715 (*store.Store).GetUser — store/user.go:148 (*store.Store).ListUsers — store/user.go:136 store.Driver.ListUsers (interface dispatch) — store/driver.go:47 (*DB).ListUsers — store/db/sqlite/user.go:88 (peers: store/db/postgres/user.go, store/db/mysql/user.go) SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user — store/db/sqlite/user.go:151 parseDataURI (decode base64 → bytes) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:737 c.Blob(200, imageType, imageData) — server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:209 ``` Details worth noting along the path: - **Auth gate (fileserver.go:173-181):** if `Profile.AllowAnonymous()` is false, `getCurrentUser` → `authenticator.AuthenticateToUser` (fileserver.go:708) must resolve a session/access token/PAT first. On a public instance, any user's avatar is served anonymously — there is no per-viewer permission check beyond that, unlike `checkAttachmentPermission` for attachments. - **Cache bypass (store/user.go:149-156):** `GetUser` only consults `userCache` when `find.ID` is set. This lookup passes `Username`, so it always falls through to `ListUsers` and hits the DB; the row is then written into the cache keyed by ID (store/user.go:143). - **MIME allowlist (fileserver.go:201):** the decoded type must be in `avatarAllowedTypes` (fileserver.go:75), and `setSecurityHeaders` sets `nosniff` + a locked-down CSP before the blob is written.
